_comment: AlterCPA user id -> USERNAME, transcribed from the AlterCPA users screen on 2026-08-05. This is the authoritative mapping: the API returns operators only as integers (`user` = who handled the lead, `app` = who approved it) and has no directory endpoint, so this screen is the only source. Names are kept exactly as AlterCPA spells them (Latin), rather than re-transliterated into Cyrillic, so they can always be traced back to the source system.
_validation: Cross-checked against the collabBox-derived map built independently from 4,881 matched documents. Every id the derivation accepted at >=80% dominance turned out correct — 3453 Saska Simonovska, 3780 Elena Mladenovska, 4134 Iva Kunoska, 4135 Martina Bundova, 4170 Marija Markovska, 4222 Aleksandra Hristoska, 4249 Snezana Stojkovska, 4371 Slobodanka Petrova, 4375 Sanela Dzogovich, 3835 Zaklina Denik. Every id it REJECTED as ambiguous would have been wrong — it wanted Teodora Krstevska for 2737 (really Dzan Ramkovski), Teodora Kostovska for 2821 (really Simona Krstevska), Elena Mladenovska for 3117 (really Dragana). The 80% threshold earned its keep.
_nonOperators: 3201 Analytics Agent, 4252 Test User, 2624 mrPro, 4055 Maor, 3007 Mervin, 4167 stepang and 4401 Mile Stoev are system, owner or test accounts rather than call-centre operators. They are mapped anyway so their orders are attributable, but they should not appear in agent performance reporting.
